system.flavor: Study the stance and catch the gap.

surges.html: The target suffers -1 die on its next Action before the start of your next turn.
A second creature within 5 units also becomes Exposed.

rider.title: SCHEME - CONTINGENCY
rider.html: Trigger: The Exposed target uses a Reaction. Effect: It remains Exposed until the start of your next turn instead of being consumed.
